configurationFindings: App Configuration contains direct-looking values and stale RabbitMQ keys; no Key Vault reference content types were observed.
Application code supports an APPCONFIGURATION_LABEL selector, but the first Products QA slice uses direct Container App settings while App Configuration cold-start behavior is investigated.
The AppHost helper hardcodes Development environment values and tenant-specific settings; QA deployment settings must be supplied independently.
One current service name, eshopacademy-notification-service, is 33 characters and exceeds the 32-character Container Apps name limit.
No Bicep, Terraform, azure.yaml, Container Apps, database, registry, or monitoring deployment definition exists yet.
No Azure Policy assignments or workload managed-identity role assignments were found.
Core shared resources and all newly created resources have QA ownership tags; five older AI resources rejected tag updates while their provider state was non-terminal.
Azure Files SMB is not a viable persistent volume for the official PostgreSQL image because initdb requires POSIX chmod semantics.
